verdict.rationale: Missive documents a first-party MCP server. The changelog says external AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can connect via MCP and act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with user-chosen permissions, and a probe confirms server docs at /docs/ai/mcp/server. Later changelog items reference drafts created 'through the API and MCP server', and pricing lists 'API & MCP access'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, detailed evidence of the tool surface and authentication setup, and clarity on which plan tier includes MCP access.
